data.description: Welcome to Monke Tag! A casual and competitive game, featuring gameplay in the home "Forest", to exciting PVP in the Lazer Tag Arena! If your more of a horror person, then our horror mode is the one for you! Explore the darkest depths of the caves, and uncover the horrifying secrets.. We have many cosmetics that you can pick and choose to style your Monke! We also have epic items like ModMenus, SizeChanger, and Soundboard (Requires purchase)! If this game seems like something you would wanna play, go ahead an download on the Meta Quest Store!

**Message of the day!***
Woah, that worked... I didn't think we would be back here, it feels surreal. You probably don't know what I'm talking 
about, and I don't blame you. Traveling to an entirely different reality would scramble your brain around.
All you need to know is you are safe now, and Sir T. cannot return. Enjoy the Christmas vibes, I've heard
the penguins come out around this time of year...
